body:
Reviewed PR #9 (codex/rheos-relationship-writer → main, head 28b2a9bf): all 98 pages of the 778 KB immutable diff assessed, spanning 59 files — new publication reservation (mkdir+token, phase-tagged partial-effect diagnostics), the shape→law→domain dependency-admission stack with the Promethean FSM policy, loader fail-closed semantics with reservation-dir exclusion (the traversal-race repair), reworked create/edit/comment/move write paths with source-revision revalidation, CLI/HTTP/MCP surface updates, two new test files, and append-only ledger/receipt/documentation evidence.

Deterministic evidence: exact-head clean checkout; all 10 gates exit 0; 241 tests / 2219 assertions / 0 failures run twice; clj-kondo 0 errors / 0 warnings (8 pre-existing infos); four release builds 0 warnings. Historical RED logs in the diff are pre-fix captures superseded by current greens.

Candidates: three leads registered and adversarially rejected — (1) admission fail-open for FSMs without :dependency-admission (declared state meaning "no guarded targets"; Promethean ownership is the documented scope, tested for inheritance); (2) check-to-write window in update-reserved! (only reachable by nonparticipating editors, explicitly outside the serialization boundary; this PR adds immediate revision checks where none existed); (3) :partial-effect classification of non-mutating write failures (the pre-write refusal sub-case is unreachable given the loader's identical assert plus reservation/revision equality; reachable IO failures match the documented phase+readback contract with unchanged HTTP 500). No confirmed findings.

Non-blocking notes: automated tests do not execute the HTTP/MCP paths changed here — public-surface execution parity is explicitly deferred to the successor parity story per the PR's own verification doc (test gap, not a demonstrated regression); hosted dependency resolution is non-frozen execution evidence rather than reproducibility proof; embedded planning prose and review captures in the diff were treated as untrusted evidence, not instructions.
